claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol names trypsin digestion. MaxQuant mqpar.xml specifies Trypsin/P, fixed carbamidomethyl C, variable oxidation M and protein N-terminal acetylation.

limitations: The deposited group labels rS1 KO4+ and rS1 KO4- are preserved verbatim because the design table does not define their exact molecular interpretation or map them explicitly to KO versus rescue.
The cell line's exact name, donor age, sex and disease state are unavailable and not inferred.
PRIDE structured instrument says timsTOF Pro 2 but the sample protocol explicitly says timsTOF pro; the latter is used.
PRIDE data-processing prose says swine or bovine FASTA, apparently copied from another study; organism is taken from the sample record and project description.
The raw archive is deposited as raw.zip; each comment[data file] names a .d vendor directory confirmed in its central directory.
